sourceFile: 3. BRS-161016 (DT) Report  test new machine dry date 2024.04.02_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because it merges distinct process sheets and misidentifies the changed-factor and outcomes.
issues: Changed factor mixes machine, jig, dates, temperatures, times, and processes.
SMG, CMG/Yoke, and Frame+SUS contexts are combined without clear grouping.
Baseline/test logic is inconsistent; Sub 3 has no Normal comparator.
Several outcomes are parser artifacts or header-derived measurements.
Decision evidence is incomplete, especially final use/no-use conclusions.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the three process sheets be separate review cases or one validation case?
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as new dry machine/process dry condition versus normal where supported.
Preserve sheet/process as subgroup or split into cases based on report intent.
Rebuild outcomes from real data rows, excluding header-derived statistics.
Pair Normal and Test only within the same process, date/line/type context.
Cite title, purpose, condition, result, and decision rows for each corrected case.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are misgrouped and insufficient for final evidence.
